paragraphs.text: Alara block , comprising Shards of Alara , Conflux , and Alara Reborn , has 12 intro packs , each one comes with a 41-card deck and a 15-card random booster pack, five of which are bicolored and 10 are tricolored.
Prior to Shards of Alara , wherein intro packs were debuted, preconstructed theme decks were known as theme decks.
